title: Introduce typed retry annotations and synced heartbeat wrappers across Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Priya Desai
ci_checks: e2e: flaky - rerun succeeded on second run
release_notes: Adds language-specific ergonomics for typed retry annotations: decorators in TS, context-managers in Python, functional options in Go. Backwards compatible; opt-in via new SDK config flag. Includes synced heartbeat helper for long-lived streaming sessions.
description:
Motivation: customers have repeatedly asked for clearer, type-level retry intent that can be enforced by SDKs and surfaced in telemetry. This PR introduces a small, language-native surface that lets callers declare retry semantics close to callsites and gives runtime helpers (heartbeat + soft-fail policy) for long-lived streaming sessions to avoid transient auth flaps.

Summary of changes (single continuous description):
- Introduce a portable "RetryAnnotation" model and language-specific bindings: TypeScript uses a @retry({policy}) decorator for generated client methods; Python exposes RetryAnnotation as a typed dataclass and a contextmanager helper; Go exposes a functional option RetryAnnotation(...) and a typed RetryPolicy enum.
- Heartbeat wrapper: a lightweight session.Heartbeat helper that pins a background heartbeat + jittered backoff to keep token leases alive for streaming connections. Designed to be safe with existing heartbeat/keepalive primitives.
- Telemetry hooks: the SDKs will emit retry.annotation and retry.decision tags so backends can correlate policies to observed retries.
- Migration notes: default behavior unchanged; new API is opt-in behind `enableTypedRetryAnnotations` feature flag in SDK config; small samples added to each SDK's docs and examples.
- Tests: unit tests for annotation parsing and examples, integration tests exercising heartbeat with a mock auth proxy (flaky on windows, retried in CI).

Implementation detail summary: commits touch language-specific client generators (ts-client-gen, py-client-gen, go-client-gen), a small shared proto/json schema for the annotation payload, and adapters in each SDK runtime that translate the annotation into per-transport retry hooks.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-5941) [x] automated unit tests [x] integration smoke tests [x] docs examples updated [x] telemetry events instrumented [x] feature-flag gate added

Notes:
- Kept primitives minimal; the goal is ergonomic opt-in that doesn't expand surface area drastically.
- This PR intentionally does not replace existing retry presets or the retry DSL; it layers a thin, typed hint on top.
- Performance impact: microbenchmarks show <0.5% added latency on cold-paths and negligible memory impact.
- Follow-ups: telemetry dashboards (ENG-6012) and an example migration guide for large codebases.
